title: Sparkly scooter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff8b0' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fff8b0' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe96b'>
    <path d='M18 22 l2 6 l6 2 l-6 2 l-2 6 l-2 -6 l-6 -2 l6 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M84 30 l1.6 5 l5 1.6 l-5 1.6 l-1.6 5 l-1.6 -5 l-5 -1.6 l5 -1.6 z'/>
    <path d='M76 68 l1.4 4.4 l4.4 1.4 l-4.4 1.4 l-1.4 4.4 l-1.4 -4.4 l-4.4 -1.4 l4.4 -1.4 z'/>
    <path d='M26 70 l1.2 3.8 l3.8 1.2 l-3.8 1.2 l-1.2 3.8 l-1.2 -3.8 l-3.8 -1.2 l3.8 -1.2 z'/>
    <circle cx='14' cy='48' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='50' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='76' r='10' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='76' r='5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='10' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- frame / deck -->
  <path d='M24 66 L60 66 L62 72 L22 72 Z' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <path d='M60 66 L66 44' stroke='#4fc3f7' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- handlebar post and bars -->
  <path d='M66 44 L62 30' stroke='#7ee0c0' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M54 28 L70 30' stroke='#7ee0c0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- rear fender accent -->
  <path d='M18 72 Q24 62 30 72' fill='none' stroke='#ff8fb1' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- deck accent -->
  <rect x='30' y='67' width='26' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
  <!-- glow under sparkles -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='48' r='4' fill='url(#glow)'/>
</svg>
